summary: The exact nested disposable Data stage was updated through the package-owned updater and all 33 reviewed module/package/asset files match current source bytes and SHA-256. No Foundry process, browser tab, login, served request, installer, document, asset, Scene, or foreign state was touched.

databaseFirst.reconciliation: The authorized M1189 boundary was limited to the exact existing nested Data destination and read-only source/staged attestation. The in-app browser was not used and no runtime lifecycle action was required.

decision.reason: M1188 corrected source bytes are now present exactly in the nested Data stage, but staged parity does not prove HTTP-served bytes, loaded module identity, runtime authority, persistent-world commit, or post-restart completeness.
decision.nextBoundary: M1190: perform one allowlisted served-byte hash attestation for the current M1188 installer/module/package identity without browser login or installer invocation.

remainingBlockers: Current M1188 bytes are staged but not yet served-byte attested.
Loaded-byte identity, runtime write authority, persistent-world commit, and post-restart authoritative completeness remain unproven.
Tram/Core final maps, player/Regionwright behavior, and player acceptance remain unproven.
